messages:
marta: FYI I hit a weird streaming bug in the browser sample app after the auth token refresh flow. The UI shows repeated partial tokens and sometimes a small gap then the remainders arrive out of order.
aj: ugh. do you have a repro? browser only or node too?
marta: browser only so far (chrome). steps: start stream -> wait for token expiry -> refresh -> reconnect -> first chunk contains tail of previous message followed by beginning of new response, sometimes duplicated words.
kevin: could be the reconnect logic concatenating buffered chunks incorrectly. Are you using the fetch polyfill from examples?
marta: yes, using sample fetch + EventSource fallback. I suspect two things: 1) when we re-open the SSE we re-send an incomplete last-chunk, and 2) the auth refresh triggers a quick disconnect+reconnect so the server sends overlap.
sam: can you paste the raw SSE frames? if it's SSE we should see id/data lines.
marta: pasted below (trimmed):
```
: keep-alive
data: {"delta":"...token-pa

"}

id: 42
retry: 3000
data: {"delta":"rtial word

"}
```
aj: hmm that looks like the client cut in the middle of a UTF-8 seq? but the data fields are split oddly. Are we accidentally buffering at the fetch layer and then slicing by bytes?
kevin: the browser sample uses a ReadableStream pump that slices by chunks received. If auth refresh returns a 401 then we call controller.close() and re-open. There might be a race where the remaining queued chunks are flushed into the new reader.
ci-bot: CI:stream-tests failed on node-sse-reconnect (test 7) — flakiness detected.
aj: node tests failing too — ok parity issue. Node's sdk uses `eventsource` package which handles partial frames differently than the browser ReadableStream.
marta: so two separate bugs: parser state not reset properly on reconnect, and auth+reconnect flow not draining buffers cleanly. Also sample app doesn't show how to set `lastEventId` header for resume. onboarding friction there.
sam: quick patch idea: keep an explicit parser state object per connection; on reconnect, drain it and increment a stream-epoch token so buffered data from old connection is ignored.
kevin: agreed. also add a brief note in the browser sample about using `keepalive` and not relying on fetch polyfills that change chunk boundaries. can we add a small e2e that simulates auth refresh mid-stream?
aj: I'll add the parser fix in node and the stream-epoch gating for browser. I'll also add a test that injects a fake 401 in the middle of a stream.
marta: thanks. small UX ask: sample app should surface a single-line status: "reconnecting (auth refresh)" instead of spamming reconnection logs. New users get confused.
kevin: good call, UI tweak. also add a troubleshooting note: "If you see duplicated tokens, check your client-side reconnect handler and polyfills."
aj: PR incoming in ~2h. I'll tag @kevin for sample app changes.
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for bundle-3141 — includes devex/sample-sse-fix. ETA 12m.
ci-bot: CI:stream-tests now passing locally (aj) but flaky in pipeline — keeping an eye.
marta: awesome. once deployed I'll run the browser repro and paste logs. thanks y'all :rocket:
